pagerduty-bot: [PagerDuty] ALERT fired: runtime-latency-eu-west1 — 12 triggers in 2m, p95 > 1200ms; service: runtime-gateway; severity: P2; link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-98765
incident-bot: Incident created (INC-2026) and paging on-call — auto-escalation set to 3m if unacked
maria.dev: ACKing — on it, pulling dashboards now :eyes:
ashwin: I'll jump in too; just finishing the deploy watch, can take lead if needed
jon.sre: looking at infra metrics. seeing a short 30s spike in p95 across pool-eu-west-A, CPU & GPU load normal. interestingly only 6 of 24 hosts showed the spike
maria.dev: console shows a KV-cache miss spike at the same timestamp, cache hit-rate dipped from 98% -> 70% for ~45s
maria.dev: quick check logs: ```rwinfctl logs -p eu-west1 --since 5m | grep "cache miss" | tail -n 50```
ashwin: running that now, also checking router traces for request fanout; could be a transient policy misroute or a small cache eviction test run
jon.sre: no error 5xx in gateway, just latency. PD shows no related storage alarms. probably noisy eviction or a customer workload burst
pagerduty-bot: Alert auto-resolved (PD-98765) — condition cleared after 3m, incident auto-closed by system
ashwin: :white_check_mark: looks like transient. PD auto-resolved before we fully escalated. no manual ack escalation required
maria.dev: flagged a few client request IDs that hit high latencies, saving for postmortem. snapshot: logs/1873502468-spike-snap.txt
samira: FYI support: ACME reported intermittent slowdown around 12:10-12:13 UTC, filed ticket INC-1234, forwarded logs to us. they saw UX slowness but no errors
jon.sre: action item: this is flappy — recommend tune alert to require sustained 60s threshold or 3/5 evaluation window to reduce noise
maria.dev: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up to adjust the alerting rule and add a short suppression for cache-miss correlated spikes. PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/alerts/pull/482 
ashwin: also adding a runbook step: if KV miss spike + no 5xx, wait 2m before paging infra, escalate to runtime-team only if repeated within 10m (SRE-456)
maria.dev: added tags on the incident: noisy-burst, autoclose, follow-up. creating a short postmortem note in #postmortems if it recurs
ashwin: handoff note for shift: no current pager, leaving to night oncall (samira) in 35m. if it pops again, please check cache eviction metrics first and ping me @ashwin
maria.dev: thanks team — closing thread. I recorded timeline and attached logs to INC-2026. low customer impact but follow-up required. :relieved:
samira: thanks, noted. I'll watch overnight and update if anything reappears
